measurementLimits: Pipeline-load timers exclude prior Capsule verification; elapsedMs covers the complete lifecycle sequence, not single-request TTFT.
Local repository/UI checks also ran during the investigation; model runs were sequential. These are local acceptance/tuning observations, not a vendor benchmark or confidence interval.
GPU counters observe explicit destruction, not physical driver residency or garbage collection.
Per-session backing leases must not be summed as unique allocation. Cache budgets exclude backing and loader/GPU resources.
